name: Rene A. Gagnon

roles.title: Private First Class, Company E, 2nd Battalion, 28th Marines, 5th Marine Division

summary: A mill-town Marine from Manchester, New Hampshire, who carried the second flag up Suribachi in his pack and was one of the three survivors sent home to raise money on the strength of the photograph. He was identified as one of the raisers from 1945 until October 2019, when the Marine Corps concluded the figure was Harold Keller. Gagnon supplied several of the original identifications himself in Washington in April 1945, from memory, days after the event and under considerable pressure — which is how the misidentifications entered the record in the first place, and why the story is less about deceit than about what was being asked of nineteen-year-olds in a bond drive.
